title: Shinonome Ena — An Overwhelming Welcome!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Fleur Libre Pop-up Store

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you for giving us a chance to try on so many different outfits today. We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
I hope you get a lot of use out of those detachable collars you ended up liking so much!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes, and I'll handle them with great care!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Feel free to come back again anytime while we're here, everyone! I'll see you again at home, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! Good luck with work, Sis!
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks for inviting us to visit the shop with you, Mizuki! That was fun, and I got my hands on these super cute collars.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome♪
And I'm glad that I finally got to introduce you to my big sis, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You seemed startled by Yuki's exuberance, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I knew she'd be excitable and talkative like Mizuki, but she went way beyond my expectations.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I sort of know what you mean.
She was also very excited when Mafuyu and I met her for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But not as excited as she was today, I think.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Probably because I've told her so much about you, Ena. I always said there was one more person I absolutely had to introduce her to.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I think she couldn't wait to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh...?
You told her a lot about me? Can you tell me what exactly?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Obviously, that you're an incredibly skilled artist and fashionable person who's always looking out for others!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm glad for you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It doesn't really sound like you are.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, is that what you really told her?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It is! Look into my eyes!
Is this the face of a fibber?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, you are absolutely not trustworthy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?!
You believe me, right, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Umm, well...
She did seem very happy to see you, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I'm inclined to believe that Mizuki told her some very good things about you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Remember the look on her face when she saw you at the store?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Yes, I had a feeling that you were Ena!
It's so great to finally meet you!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, she was really happy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: See?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I was pretty careful not to give her a weird impression of you right before you two met in person.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
I've been meaning to mention one thing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You really surprised me when you talked to her the way you talk to us, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mizuki said that I didn't have to put on a face for her when we met her for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? So, you've talked to her like normal since you met?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, she didn't find it strange at all...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She probably figured that Mafuyu has her reasons. She didn't ask me anything afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? Normally, people would ask questions...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki's sister is such an amazing person.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Of course she is.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I mean, she's always understood and supported Mizuki too.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And after speaking to her, I feel like she's a really great big sister.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena? Something on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Nothing.
